name: Mold Rhymes With...
objectiveText: Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan. Imbued Skeletal Fragments (Provided)  ( 1 )   Required money: 15  ( 1 )

comments.body:
BEFORE U LEAVE THIS CONTINENT, UNLESS U R A MINER AND HAVE THORIUM BARS ON YOU, STOP IN THE AH IN IF AND BUY 2 THORIUM BARS.

for this part, all you need to do is fly from chillwood camp to menethil harbor, then take boat to dustwallow marsh, then gryph to tanaris/gadget. pay the guy, then head on to un'goro crater.

If you're a warlock, you dont need to do this for the scholo key. At the door to scholomance, lifetap down to as little HP as you can, then use hellfire. As a ghost, walk back to your corpse, but res on the other side of the door - don't worry, you dont lose durability.

I waited until 60 to do this and by the time I had finished the chain and defeated Araj (also completing [url=/quest=211]Alas Anderhol[/url] at the same time) the quest rewards had more than compensated for the expense of the mold and Thorium Bars.

Finish the quest, pay 15 gold, and get the key.

Or don't.

No one cares.
If you're a Rogue and near 300 lockpicking, skip this and save yourself 15g. Just get to 300 :)

Yeah, or you could go through the chain and realise that the last quest, where you kill the summoner, you get 23k xp for completing...

15g for 23k xp = Fair?

On the off chance that you want the highest dps blue weap in the game, you'll need to 5-man Scholo a few times.  In a 5man shooting for a mostly undead inst, chances are you be going without a rogue once or twice.  And relying on other people to spend their money and effort for your convenience is hardly wise.  Not that they'd begrudge it to you, but they probably are relying on you.  15g for a weap that will comfortably serve you until your first epic isn't bad.  If you already have an epic, I'm not sure why you'd bother with this instance anyways, so I don't know why you'd complain. . . .

If you are a Warlock, you MUST go into Scholo as part of your quest for Dreadsteed (the 'imp in a jar' part).

But i guess you could also die/res through the door as someone suggested (haven't tried that yet).

Then again... a scholo key will always be usefull if you are in a guild that does dungeons just for the fun of it :)
I'm sitting here thinking, 15 gold is a steep quest requirement.  Has anyone finished the rest of the steps?  What is the reward?  Is it better than 15 gold?
replies: Check out the quest The Ectoplasmic Distiller....he asks for 40g along with some other expensive &*!@e!

comments.body:
Unless you are an obsessed WoW freak (having no time to farm some stuff to sell or make stuff to sell), 15 gold at level 60 is nothing.

It seems like a lot after levelling up your first character to 60, but once you realize you can go just about anywhere, including soloing instances that used to kick your a$$, it's just a matter of finding profitable stuff to farm/make/sell.

For instance, I made 70 gold in 6 days leveling up my cooking skill and selling the stuff I made to level up.  (I never levelled my cooking because I didn't need it as a Druid)  That's 6 days at 2-3 hours/day, by the way, not 16 hours a day like some people.

That's cooking -- mid to high-level food goes for 1-3 gold per stack of 10-20.  The leatherworking cash cows (at least on Llane server) are rugged armor kits and heavy leather.  I can farm about 30 rugged armor kits in a 2-3 hour night, and they go for 1.0-1.5 gold each at AH.  Don't ask me why, but stacks of 10 heavy leather sell for 1 gold each (more than thick leather), which is ridiculously easy to farm in Stranglethorn.

So, I could easily farm 30 gold per night, but straight farming is boring, so just mix and match.

Just start by looking at the most expensive consumable and trade items in your server's AH...
With finishing the follow up quests, you are getting 8 gold back

Bring 2 thorium bars with you before you make the trek.  It sends you to un'goro after paying the 15 gold and 2 thorium bars are needed, then back to gaget.

[quote]I'm an alchemist, not a banker. If I had gold lying around, I certainly wouldn't be here.[/quote]

The irony of this statement hurts.
This quest is for getting the key made for the scholomance. Yes, if you can lockpick save your money. I'm not even sure if I should have spend the 15g, someone will always have a key.

Total waste of time and money.  First you pay the 15G, then you have to go to Tanaris. The goblin will give you a mold, you'll need to take the mold and 2 thorium bars to Un'Goro to smelt the key in the lava.  Then you turn in the quest back at the Bulwark... but you aren't done.

You then have to kill the Lich King in Andorhal. A 61 Elite with an army surrounding him.
Is the 15 gold worth it? What are the rewards for this and the following quests?

well one would assume that by the level 50 15 gold should not be a problem anymore...so if you ever want to do scholomance with your group without the need of a rogue...i say it's worthy. Though it's no need to actually take the 2 thorium bars with you...they're needed for the next part of this.
